# BNG Controller — Review Alert Rules

Read `bng://alerts/configured` to list the `PrometheusRule` objects deployed in all namespaces.

## Which Prometheus instances actually evaluate rules
- `nok-bng/bng-tel-prom`: requires labels `role=alert-rules`; namespace restricted to its own namespace (`nok-bng`) — the rule must live there; `evaluationInterval=30s`, `scrapeInterval=15s`.

## What to report, per rule
- Whether it is an alerting rule (`alert`) or a recording rule (`record`) — this controller only creates alerting rules, but the resource reports whatever is actually deployed.
- Its labels, and whether they satisfy at least one instance's `ruleSelector` above — a rule whose labels don't match is deployed but **never evaluated**.
- Whether its namespace is one the matching instance's `ruleNamespaceSelector` actually covers.

Group the answer into rules that are actively evaluated versus rules that are present but inert (label or namespace mismatch).
